title: E-Commerce Refund Delays & Return Denials
summary: Procedural roadmap when an online marketplace or seller delays processing your return or stalls your refund beyond statutory time limits.
typical_situation: An online order arrives wrong, defective, or damaged, or was cancelled within the platform's return window. Despite courier pickup or order cancellation, the marketplace fails to initiate the monetary refund or customer care repeatedly defers the turnaround date.
problem_statement: An online shopping platform or merchant delays processing a valid monetary refund for returned or cancelled merchandise beyond committed timelines, or customer support provides evasive responses without issuing a resolution.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Log Formal Return on Platform & Record Ticket ID
step_by_step_procedure.description: Initiate return/refund request within the platform's return window via the mobile application or website. Take clear screenshots of the return request confirmation, pickup status, and cited return reason.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Within platform's return window (typically 7–10 days of delivery)

step_by_step_procedure.title: Issue Written Escalation to Platform Grievance Officer
step_by_step_procedure.description: If customer care fails to process refund within 48–72 hours after return pickup, email the designated Grievance Officer (mandatory under Rule 4(5) of the Consumer Protection E-Commerce Rules, 2020). State order number, dates, courier tracking slip number, and demand refund within a specific timeframe.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Grievance Officer must acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and dispose within 1 month

step_by_step_procedure.title: Register Pre-Litigation Grievance on National Consumer Helpline (1915)
step_by_step_procedure.description: If company grievance desk does not respond or denies refund unfairly, register a grievance on the National Consumer Helpline portal (consumerhelpline.gov.in) or call toll-free 1915. Major Indian e-commerce entities are convergence partners and actively resolve tickets here.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Typically processed within 15 to 30 days under convergence

step_by_step_procedure.title: File Formal Consumer Case via e-Jagriti Portal
step_by_step_procedure.description: If NCH convergence does not yield resolution, file an electronic complaint petition before the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission via e-Jagriti (e-jagriti.gov.in). Under Section 34(2)(d) of CPA 2019, you can institute the case in the District Commission where you reside.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Must be instituted within 2 years from date on which cause of action arose (Section 69 CPA 2019)

officially_specified_documents: Retail tax invoice / bill with GSTIN, seller address, and order ID (mandatory for e-Jagriti commission filing)
Affidavit of complaint and verification in prescribed e-Jagriti format if filing formally before consumer commission
useful_to_preserve: Courier return pickup receipt or digital tracking screenshot showing item handed over to logistics agent
Unboxing video and high-resolution photographs taken immediately upon package arrival showing defect or wrong item
Full email correspondence and customer support chat transcripts with ticket reference numbers
Bank or payment wallet statement showing original debit and non-receipt of refund credit
conditional_documents: Manufacturer or brand authorized inspection report (applicable if seller claims customer caused damage)
Bank transaction dispute / chargeback request confirmation (if dispute was also escalated to card-issuing bank)

required_evidence: Retail tax invoice / bill with GSTIN, seller address, and order ID
Courier return pickup receipt or tracking screenshot showing package handed over
Unboxing video / photos capturing product condition upon delivery
Transcript or screenshots of customer support chat tickets and emails
Bank/card account statement demonstrating debit and non-receipt of refund
official_remedy_channel: National Consumer Helpline (NCH 1915) followed by District Consumer Commission via e-Jagriti
caveats_and_escalation: Educational Notice: Filing a grievance on NCH or e-Jagriti does not guarantee an automatic refund or monetary outcome. Commission proceedings are quasi-judicial. Under Section 69 of CPA 2019, formal court claims must be instituted within two (2) years of the cause of action. Claims claiming consideration up to ₹5 Lakh enjoy complete court fee exemption.

title: Defective Consumer Goods & Warranty Denial
summary: Statutory procedure when an electronic gadget, appliance, or household product develops manufacturing faults and the brand refuses warranty repair or replacement.
typical_situation: An appliance or smartphone malfunctions during the manufacturer's warranty period. The authorized service center rejects free warranty repair citing unsubstantiated grounds (such as alleged internal moisture or customer mishandling) or keeps the unit indefinitely without spare parts.
problem_statement: A manufactured consumer item develops functional or hardware defects within the contractual or statutory warranty period, and the brand or authorized service center refuses repair, replacement, or refund.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Deposit Item at Authorized Center & Obtain Printed Job Sheet
step_by_step_procedure.description: Submit device only to the manufacturer's officially authorized service center. Insist on a printed or digitally acknowledged Service Job Sheet documenting exact serial number, intake physical condition, and reported defect.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Issue Written Legal Notice to Brand Customer Relations Head
step_by_step_procedure.description: If service is delayed beyond a reasonable window (typically 14–21 days) or warranty is arbitrarily denied, send a formal written notice via registered email to the brand's customer relations head demanding repair, replacement, or refund within 15 days under Section 39 of CPA 2019.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Lodge Grievance on National Consumer Helpline (1915)
step_by_step_procedure.description: Call NCH at 1915 or register an online ticket on consumerhelpline.gov.in quoting job sheet number and brand warranty policy. Most established electronics brands participate in NCH convergence.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: 15 to 30 days for company convergence outcome

step_by_step_procedure.title: File Product Defect Complaint on e-Jagriti
step_by_step_procedure.description: File petition before the District Consumer Commission via e-Jagriti (e-jagriti.gov.in) praying for free replacement with defect-free unit, or full refund with interest and compensation for mental harassment.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Within 2 years of cause of action (Section 69 CPA 2019)

officially_specified_documents: Retail purchase tax invoice showing GSTIN, serial number/IMEI, and purchase date
Signed complaint petition and verification affidavit (for e-Jagriti filing)
useful_to_preserve: Physical warranty card or digital warranty registration email
Authorized Service Center Job Sheets (both intake diagnosis note and return slips)
Photographic or video evidence capturing the device malfunction or defect clearly
Email correspondence with corporate customer escalation desk
conditional_documents: Independent technical expert inspection report (applicable if brand disputes manufacturing flaw and Commission orders lab testing under Section 38(2)(c) CPA 2019)

required_evidence: Retail purchase invoice with GSTIN, serial number, and date
Physical warranty card or digital warranty confirmation
Authorized service center job sheets with diagnostic observations
Photographic or video evidence capturing device defect
Email correspondence with brand customer relations
official_remedy_channel: National Consumer Helpline (1915) & District Consumer Commission (e-Jagriti)
caveats_and_escalation: Educational Notice: Consumer Commissions assess evidence quasi-judicially. If the company claims physical accidental damage, the commission may refer the product to an accredited testing laboratory under Section 38(2)(c) of CPA 2019. Claims up to ₹5 Lakh have NIL court fee.

title: Wrong Product or Spurious Item Delivered
summary: Actions to take when an e-commerce parcel delivers an incorrect item, empty box, or suspected counterfeit product.
typical_situation: An online order arrives, but inside the parcel is a completely different product (e.g. soap or detergent instead of an expensive smartphone) or a counterfeit knockoff lacking genuine brand packaging.
problem_statement: A customer receives a product that does not match the product description, brand, or specifications ordered on an e-commerce platform.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Capture Unboxing Evidence & Preserve Outer Packaging
step_by_step_procedure.description: Preserve outer carton, shipping label, airway bill (AWB) barcode, and tamper-evident seal. Take clear photographs from multiple angles and keep uncut unboxing video.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Report Wrong Item on Platform Within 24 Hours
step_by_step_procedure.description: Log an immediate return request under 'Wrong Item Delivered' on the platform app. Upload photographs showing barcode label and the mismatch.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Escalate to E-Commerce Nodal Grievance Officer
step_by_step_procedure.description: If delivery agent refuses pickup or platform closes ticket claiming 'delivered successfully', email the Grievance Officer with invoice, shipping barcode photo, and unboxing proof. Cite Rule 4(5) of E-Commerce Rules, 2020.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Grievance Officer must acknowledge within 48 hours

step_by_step_procedure.title: Lodge Grievance with National Consumer Helpline & Cyber Portal if Fraud
step_by_step_procedure.description: Register grievance on NCH 1915 (consumerhelpline.gov.in). If deliberate e-commerce seller fraud or empty parcel scam is suspected, also flag transaction on cybercrime.gov.in.

officially_specified_documents: Retail tax invoice showing order details and payment mode
Complaint statement specifying mismatch between ordered and delivered product
useful_to_preserve: Uncut, continuous video recording showing package unboxing and seal breakage
Photographs of outer box showing courier shipping label, AWB barcode, and gross weight
Photographs of incorrect item received alongside original order listing specifications
SMS and email delivery notifications indicating exact delivery timestamp
conditional_documents: Courier delivery run-sheet or OTP verification log (applicable if courier claims package was inspected before handover)

required_evidence: Tax invoice and online order summary screenshot
Photographs of outer packaging, shipping barcode, and courier label
Uncut unboxing video showing seal breakage and contents
Written customer service complaint ticket number
official_remedy_channel: National Consumer Helpline (1915) & District Consumer Commission (e-Jagriti)
caveats_and_escalation: Educational Notice: Open-box delivery services (where offered by platforms) require inspection before sharing OTP. If open-box delivery was accepted with OTP, platforms often contest claims. Preserving uncut unboxing videos remains crucial supporting evidence.

title: Overcharging Above Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
summary: Remedies when a retailer, airport stall, or convenience vendor charges more than printed MRP or adds illegal cooling/refrigeration fees.
typical_situation: A vendor charges ₹5 to ₹10 extra on a cold drink bottle or packaged snack, claiming 'chilling charges', 'handling fee', or adds tax separately on top of an MRP that is already tax-inclusive.
problem_statement: A pre-packaged commodity is sold at a price exceeding the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) printed on the package, in direct violation of Legal Metrology regulations.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Inspect Package MRP Label for Re-stickering or Tampering
step_by_step_procedure.description: Check printed MRP label on package. Note whether an unauthorized price sticker has been pasted over the original manufacturer print. Ensure MRP includes 'inclusive of all taxes'.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Demand Itemized Printed Bill Clearly Stating Price Charged
step_by_step_procedure.description: Insist on a printed cash memo or tax invoice showing the exact amount demanded and paid for the specific item.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Object to Cooling Charges Citing Rule 18(2)
step_by_step_procedure.description: Politely inform vendor that under Rule 18(2) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, charging above MRP for chilling is strictly illegal and constitutes an unfair trade practice.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Report to State Legal Metrology Department & NCH (1915)
step_by_step_procedure.description: Lodge complaint on National Consumer Helpline (consumerhelpline.gov.in / 1915) or directly with the local Controller / Inspector of Legal Metrology (Weights & Measures Department). Legal Metrology inspectors have statutory authority to conduct surprise inspections and levy compounding fines.

officially_specified_documents: Printed retail receipt or tax invoice indicating higher price charged
Clear photograph of the package showing manufacturer stamped MRP and batch number
useful_to_preserve: Photographs of the shop front, signboard, and address / location pin
Physical packaged container (preserve unopened if re-stickered or tampered)
conditional_documents: Dining menu card (applicable only if vendor is a sit-down restaurant claiming composite dining service exception)

required_evidence: Clear photograph of packaging displaying stamped MRP and batch number
Itemized retail receipt / invoice showing amount charged exceeding MRP
Store name, address, and location details
official_remedy_channel: State Legal Metrology Department & National Consumer Helpline (1915)
caveats_and_escalation: Crucial Legal Caveat: Under established Supreme Court jurisprudence (FHRAI ruling), when packaged beverages are served as part of composite dining service inside sit-down hotels and restaurants (with seating, cutlery, service, and ambiance), establishments are exempt from retail MRP restrictions and can charge menu rates. However, standalone kiosks, takeaway counters, cinema concession stands, and airport retail stalls selling raw sealed bottles are NOT exempt and must strictly adhere to printed MRP.

title: Failed UPI & Digital Payments Debited but Not Credited
summary: Rights and mandatory compensation when money is debited from your bank account during a failed UPI, card, or ATM transaction without timely auto-reversal.
typical_situation: You scan a merchant QR code or initiate a UPI fund transfer. The transaction fails on screen, but your bank account is debited immediately. The merchant does not receive credit, and the reversal does not happen within 24 hours.
problem_statement: An authorized electronic payment fails due to technical or communication glitches, but the customer account is debited without automated reversal within prescribed regulatory timelines.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Record 12-Digit UTR Number on UPI Application
step_by_step_procedure.description: Open payment history in your UPI app (BHIM, PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm). Note down the 12-digit Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) number and exact timestamp.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Raise In-App Dispute Ticket
step_by_step_procedure.description: Submit a dispute ticket directly within the UPI application quoting the UTR number. The app communicates with the Remitter Bank and NPCI.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Check Auto-Reversal Within Mandatory TAT (T+1 Day)
step_by_step_procedure.description: Under RBI Circular DPSS.CO.PD No.629/02.01.014/2019-20, the remitter bank must automatically reverse a failed UPI transaction by T+1 business day.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Claim Mandatory Delay Compensation (₹100/Day)
step_by_step_procedure.description: If reversal takes longer than T+1 business day, the bank is statutorily liable to pay compensation of ₹100 per day of delay directly into your bank account suo motu (without requiring a separate claim).

step_by_step_procedure.title: Escalate to Bank Grievance Redressal Officer & RBI Ombudsman
step_by_step_procedure.description: If unresolved after 30 days of filing with bank, lodge complaint on the RBI Integrated Ombudsman portal (cms.rbi.org.in) or call toll-free 14448.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Within 1 year of bank's final response or 30 days after lodging complaint

officially_specified_documents: 12-digit UTR (Unique Transaction Reference) number and transaction timestamp
Bank account statement showing debit entry and absence of reversal credit
useful_to_preserve: Screenshot of failed transaction error screen on payment app
In-app dispute ticket reference number and acknowledgement email from payment app
Written grievance email sent to bank nodal officer
conditional_documents: Merchant confirmation statement (applicable if merchant claims money was received but goods not handed over)

required_evidence: 12-digit UTR number and transaction date/time
Bank account statement showing debit entry
UPI payment application failure screenshot
Bank customer complaint ticket reference number
official_remedy_channel: Remitter Bank Grievance Desk, then RBI Integrated Ombudsman (cms.rbi.org.in / 14448)
caveats_and_escalation: Educational Notice: The RBI turnaround timeline applies to technical failures where the customer did not intentionally authorize payment to an incorrect account number/VPA. If a customer was coerced into an online cyber scam, report immediately on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.

title: Deceptive UI & Dark Patterns in Online Shopping
summary: How to identify and challenge deceptive digital interfaces like sneak-in-basket, subscription traps, false urgency timers, and hidden drip pricing.
typical_situation: An online platform shows an attractive airfare or product price of ₹1,000. At the final checkout screen, undisclosed fees inflate the total to ₹1,600 (drip pricing), an unrequested donation is sneaked into the cart (basket sneaking), or cancellation is blocked by complex multi-step menus (subscription trap).
problem_statement: An e-commerce website or mobile application uses deceptive user interface designs (dark patterns) to trick or coerce consumers into unwanted expenditures or subvert free choice.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Identify the Specific Dark Pattern Category
step_by_step_procedure.description: Check if the deceptive element matches one of the 13 prohibited patterns under CCPA 2023 Guidelines (e.g., False Urgency, Basket Sneaking, Confirm Shaming, Forced Action, Subscription Trap, Drip Pricing).

step_by_step_procedure.title: Capture Screen Recordings & Sequential Screenshots
step_by_step_procedure.description: Take timestamped screenshots of every step from product listing to checkout cart, capturing how hidden charges appeared or how pre-ticked boxes were configured.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Manually Deselect Sneaked Items & Demand Refund if Charged
step_by_step_procedure.description: If an unrequested item was sneaked into the billing without explicit affirmative consent, demand immediate refund from the platform's Grievance Officer citing CCPA Guidelines.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Report Platform Practice to CCPA & National Consumer Helpline
step_by_step_procedure.description: Lodge report on consumerhelpline.gov.in (NCH 1915) or directly email Central Consumer Protection Authority (cp-da@nic.in) for investigation into unfair trade practices.

officially_specified_documents: Final invoice or payment confirmation demonstrating added unauthorized charge
Formal complaint detailing the deceptive interface mechanism encountered
useful_to_preserve: Full-screen screenshots or screen recordings showing deceptive countdown timers, hidden fees, or pre-ticked checkboxes
URL of the specific checkout page and timestamp of transaction
Email sent to platform grievance officer demanding removal or refund
conditional_documents: Terms of service or subscription cancellation policy text copied from platform

required_evidence: Screenshots of initial price display vs final checkout billing
Screenshot or video recording of pre-ticked add-on / dark pattern interface
Order invoice showing added unrequested charge
Correspondence with company grievance officer
official_remedy_channel: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) & National Consumer Helpline (1915)
caveats_and_escalation: Educational Notice: The CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 came into force on November 30, 2023. Individual monetary refund claims must still be pursued through the company or Consumer Commission.

title: Misleading Advertisements & False Marketing Claims
summary: Recourse against deceptive commercial ads, unverified product performance claims, bait advertising, and false celebrity endorsements.
typical_situation: A commercial brand guarantees '100% cure for hair loss in 7 days' or advertises an electronic device with '24-hour battery backup' that in reality lasts only 3 hours under normal use.
problem_statement: A commercial advertisement conveys false, exaggerated, or scientifically unsubstantiated claims regarding product efficacy, durability, or price.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Preserve the Original Advertisement Copy
step_by_step_procedure.description: Capture unedited screen recording, high-resolution screenshot, video clip, or newspaper clipping of the promotional advertisement including dates, fine-print disclaimers, and URL.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Immediately before advertisement is pulled down or altered

step_by_step_procedure.title: Document Mismatch with Actual Product Experience
step_by_step_procedure.description: Retain purchase invoice and document clear contradictions between advertised claims and actual product performance.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Submit Complaint to Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA)
step_by_step_procedure.description: Under Section 18 of CPA 2019, CCPA has statutory powers to investigate misleading advertisements, order discontinuation, impose fines up to ₹10 Lakh (up to ₹50 Lakh for repeat offenses), and ban misleading endorsers.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Direct email to CCPA (cp-da@nic.in) or Department of Consumer Affairs

step_by_step_procedure.title: File Consumer Claim for Compensation in District Commission
step_by_step_procedure.description: If you suffered direct financial loss or physical damage based on reliance on the deceptive advertisement, file a formal complaint on e-Jagriti for refund and damages.

officially_specified_documents: Original advertisement copy (video, social media link, or print advertisement clipping)
Purchase invoice proving transaction occurred subsequent to advertisement exposure
useful_to_preserve: Product packaging and instruction leaflet showing disparity with advertised specifications
Photographic or diagnostic proof showing product failure to deliver advertised capabilities
Written notice sent to company pointing out the misleading representation
conditional_documents: Independent laboratory test report (if claiming health hazard or chemical composition mismatch)

required_evidence: Original advertisement copy with publication date and platform
Retail purchase invoice with date
Photographic or technical proof of performance disparity
Communication sent to manufacturer regarding the misleading claim
official_remedy_channel: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) & e-Jagriti District Commission
caveats_and_escalation: Educational Notice: Commercial 'puffery' (generalized subjective praise like 'the best taste in the world') is distinguished legally from specific objective factual claims (e.g. 'reduces cholesterol by 40%'). Only objective, testable factual representations can be challenged as misleading.

title: Product Quality, ISI Standards & Gold Hallmarking (HUID)
summary: How to verify genuine ISI marks on consumer appliances and 6-digit Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) on gold jewellery using official BIS tools.
typical_situation: A jeweller sells gold jewellery claiming 22-karat purity without a 6-digit HUID laser mark, or a retailer sells an electric immersion rod bearing a dubious or forged ISI mark.
problem_statement: Consumer goods lack mandatory Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) quality certification, or precious metal jewellery is sold without statutory 6-digit Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID).

step_by_step_procedure.title: Inspect the 3 Mandatory Hallmarking Signs on Gold Jewellery
step_by_step_procedure.description: Every hallmarked gold item must feature: (1) BIS Logo (triangular mark), (2) Purity/Fineness (e.g., 22K916 for 22 karat), and (3) a unique 6-digit alphanumeric Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) code laser-engraved on the article.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: At the jeweller counter before purchasing

step_by_step_procedure.title: Verify HUID on Official BIS Care Mobile Application
step_by_step_procedure.description: Open official BIS Care App (available on Android and iOS). Tap 'Verify HUID' and enter the 6-digit code. The app instantly displays jeweller registration number, assaying center details, article type, and date of hallmarking.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Verify ISI Mark License Number (CML / R-Number)
step_by_step_procedure.description: For electronics and electrical goods, open BIS Care App under 'Verify License Details' and enter the 7 or 8-digit CML number printed below the ISI logo to check validity and manufacturing address.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Lodge Complaint on BIS Portal Against Fake Marks
step_by_step_procedure.description: If HUID is invalid or an uncertified product uses a fake ISI mark, file a complaint on the BIS portal (bis.gov.in) or via BIS Care app under 'Complaints'. BIS conducts statutory raids, seizes counterfeit goods, and initiates criminal prosecution under the BIS Act, 2016.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Prompt reporting prevents marketplace circulation of unsafe goods

officially_specified_documents: Tax invoice from jeweller or retailer explicitly stating the 6-digit HUID code and purity of each item
Itemized bill showing weight of precious metal and making charges separately
useful_to_preserve: High-resolution magnified photograph of the laser-engraved hallmarking signs on the article
Screenshot of BIS Care App verification result showing 'Invalid' or disparate details
Original jewellery tag and authenticity guarantee certificate
conditional_documents: Assaying laboratory testing certificate (applicable if purity is contested through a BIS-recognized testing center)

required_evidence: Tax invoice mentioning article description, weight, and 6-digit HUID code
Clear photograph of hallmarking stamp on the jewellery article
BIS Care app verification output screenshot
Store name and full address
official_remedy_channel: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS Portal / BIS Care App) & National Consumer Helpline (1915)
caveats_and_escalation: Educational Notice: Hallmarking is mandatory in designated districts across India for 14k, 18k, 20k, 22k, 23k, and 24k gold jewellery. Consumers can get hallmarked jewellery tested at any BIS-recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centre (AHC) upon paying a nominal statutory testing fee.

title: Deficiency in Telecom & Internet Broadband Services
summary: Procedural actions when an internet service provider or mobile operator experiences prolonged downtime, wrongful billing, or refuses mobile portability.
typical_situation: A broadband connection remains disconnected for weeks despite recurring subscription payments, customer care tickets are closed without on-site visits, or value-added services are billed without consent.
problem_statement: A telecommunication or internet service provider fails to deliver committed network uptime, levies unauthorized billing charges, or fails to resolve service outages within committed timelines.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Register Complaint and Demand Unique Docket Number
step_by_step_procedure.description: Lodge complaint via official service provider application or call center. It is mandatory under TRAI regulations for the operator to register the complaint and send an SMS with a unique Docket Number and committed resolution time.

step_by_step_procedure.title: Escalate to Telecom Operator Appellate Authority
step_by_step_procedure.description: If unresolved within committed docket timeline, file an appeal before the operator's designated Appellate Authority (details published on operator website) quoting original docket number.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Within 30 days of docket resolution expiry

step_by_step_procedure.title: Lodge Pre-Litigation Ticket on National Consumer Helpline (1915)
step_by_step_procedure.description: Register grievance on NCH 1915 (consumerhelpline.gov.in). Major telecom operators (Jio, Airtel, Vodafone Idea, BSNL) are convergence partners.

step_by_step_procedure.title: File Consumer Claim for Bill Waiver and Compensation
step_by_step_procedure.description: If severe outage disrupted work-from-home or caused direct financial loss, file claim before District Consumer Commission via e-Jagriti for billing waiver and compensation for deficiency in service under Section 35 CPA 2019.
step_by_step_procedure.timeline: Within 2 years of cause of action

officially_specified_documents: Customer broadband account number / subscriber ID and billing statements
Complaint docket number and SMS confirmations received from operator
useful_to_preserve: Network diagnostic logs, speed test reports with timestamps, or router optical LOS red light photos
Payment receipts and bank statements showing uninterrupted monthly fee deductions
Correspondence with telecom appellate desk
conditional_documents: Proof of financial or professional loss suffered due to continuous internet outage (for compensation prayer in Consumer Commission)

required_evidence: Broadband subscriber account ID and billing statements
SMS confirmations containing complaint docket numbers
Speed test logs or photos of router downtime indicator
Payment receipts proving current paid status
official_remedy_channel: Operator Appellate Authority, National Consumer Helpline (1915) & District Consumer Commission
caveats_and_escalation: Educational Notice: TRAI acts as an industry regulator and does not entertain individual consumer billing complaints directly. Individual dispute redressal proceeds through operator internal channels, NCH, and Consumer Commissions.
